stem: What can the reader conclude from the interaction between the pitching coach and Cameron Varga in paragraphs 17 through 20?

options.label: A
options.text: The pitching coach wants his players to always strive to improve.

options.label: B
options.text: The pitching coach is mainly concerned about winning games quickly.

options.label: C
options.text: Varga is confident in his ability to succeed in Florida.

options.label: D
options.text: Varga's number of pitches will decrease as his speed increases.
